fusions.name: Scale Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a loose scale that deals 4 damage. Its damage rises +10% per 10 tiles you have travelled (max +30%).

fusions.name: Rolling Slam
fusions.desc: Rolls into the crowd, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Seamless Curl
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, you reflect 60% of the damage you take back at its source.

fusions.name: Tucked Seams
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner.
